preconditions.description: The number of blocks in string t must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of blocks in string s must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 and c_i.islower() for l_i, c_i in t_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block in t must have a length between 1 and 1,000,000 and consist of a lowercase letter.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 and c_i.islower() for l_i, c_i in s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block in s must have a length between 1 and 1,000,000 and consist of a lowercase letter.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of occurrences of s in t as a single integer.
